messages:
Sana: quick sync 
we need to lock Q2/Q3 priorities for audit search + keystore/BYOK. customers pressed for chain-of-custody + exportability. thinking a phased delivery to buy time for infra work. thoughts?
Ethan: +1. can we firm acceptance criteria per phase so sales can promise something concrete?
Sana: my draft: phase A = searchable hot window (14d) + immutable append-only writes + tenant-level RBAC. phase B = multi-year archival with on-demand full-index exports + BYOK support.
Priya: scoring to prioritize customer asks (quick and dirty):
```
priority = max(customer_urgency, compliance_penalty*1.2) + ops_complexity*0.5 - expected_cost_slope
customer_urgency: 0-10
compliance_penalty: 0-10 (higher for finserv/health)
ops_complexity: 0-5
expected_cost_slope: 0-5
```
Priya: applied to three asks this sprint: audit-search hot index = 18, tenant-legal-hold exports = 16, BYOK handshake = 14. so audit-search edges out.
Luke: infra note: hot 14d index is doable with current indexer but needs compaction work for append-only ingest. archival indexing at scale needs separate long-term index cluster. cost estimates attached in gist: https://internal.gists/repo/archival-costs
infra-bot: perf snapshot: audit-search p95=1.2s on n=6 instances, ingest steady 400 eps, index hit rate ~78% for 14d cache
Ethan: acceptance for phase A (audit-search): p95 < 1.5s on 14d for 95% tenants, export JSON/CSV for 500k events < 3m, immutable write-audit log, tenant masking rules enforced.
Sana: legal ask: legal-bot, will phased delivery break enterprise contracts? we can offer contract addendum that lists features by milestone.
legal-bot: legal: phased approach acceptable if we include mandatory emergency export SLA (48h) and explicit chain-of-custody guarantees; also need retention-lane opt-ins documented for customers under legal hold.
Luke: ops constraint: 3yr cold storage needs encryption-at-rest that supports rotating KEKs. that's what BYOK ties into. BYOK early adoption will complicate rotation testing.
Priya: proposal: ship phase A in Q2 (baseline audit-search), ship BYOK pilot for 1-2 customers in parallel (Q2 pilot), full BYOK GA in Q3 with rotation API and revoke path.
Ethan: pricing model idea: add "compliance tier" with per-tenant retention buckets (standard=30d, compliant=3yr, archived=7yr) with surcharge per GB-month plus export credits.
Sana: decision ask: do we greenlight phase A in Q2 + BYOK pilot?
Priya: :thumbsup: from me.
Luke: :+1: but need infra hiring buffer for indexer work.
Ethan: agree. if a finserv customer signs PO we start BYOK pilot earlier.
Sana: I'll author a short product brief + milestone SLAs and create the epic. follow-ups: Sana -> product brief + SLA wording; Luke -> infra cost & hiring ask; Priya -> pricing lanes doc; Ethan -> pilot customer outreach.
infra-bot: jira: created epic PRO-7881 (audit-search phase A) and PRO-7882 (BYOK pilot)
